committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 13 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing-page test has logged 108 raw paid clicks for $754.48 ex-GST spend (about $6.99 per click), and the $600 promo credit is now fully used (creditRemainingExGst $0), which lines up with campaignStatus showing PAUSED.

Impression share sits at 10% with rank lost at 77.1% against budget lost of only 13.9% over 30 days, and adsChanges shows zero external edits in the last 24h or 7d, so nothing outside Chris has contaminated recent test numbers.

Of 108 raw clicks on /free-workflow-review.html since 6 Oct, ask_cta_click sits at 20 and quick_question_click at 5, but review_cta_click is still 0; the page has been frozen since click 25 so none of this can be tweaked now.

Organic Search nearly doubled to 14 sessions from 6 (google/organic 13 vs 4), the only trustworthy unpaid signal this week, while AI Assistant visits and LinkedIn both stayed at zero even as Direct rose to 29 from 14, suggesting untagged AI or LinkedIn referrals are hiding there.

actions.text: The $600 promo credit is fully spent and the campaign is already PAUSED; keep it paused unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked the review (review_cta_click is still 0).
totalPaidClicks has reached 108, past the 75-click checkpoint; check the test log now, and if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries the red flag has fired.
totalPaidClicks has long passed 25, so the landing page stays frozen: no further headline, offer or CTA changes unless the page is broken.
generate_lead has fired 3 times since the test started; pull the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source data and grade each against the qualified rule before counting them as demand.
Logo and image assets for the currently serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin saved per week and 99.6% success; update them to match current site stats.

weekly: 108 raw paid clicks and $754.48 ex-GST spend have used up the full $600 promo credit, and the campaign is now paused with zero review bookings (review_cta_click 0) against the pause rule.
sessions rose to 63 last 7 days from 37 prior (up 70%), with Thu 12 matching last week's Thu 5 at 7 sessions each.
generate_lead fired 3 times since the test started and leads.last7 sits at 2 versus 1 prior, but every one needs grading against the qualified rule before counting as demand.
Organic Search strengthened while AI Assistant stayed silent,

organic sessions nearly doubled to 14 from 6 (google/organic 13 vs 4), but AI Assistant visits and LinkedIn both held at zero even though Direct nearly doubled to 29, suggesting untagged AI or LinkedIn clicks are hiding there.

Search Console data through 10 November (two days behind) shows just 6 clicks from 191 impressions over 8 days, with the simpro-xero-integration page getting 80 impressions but only 1 click at position 14.
